#
 The Five
 Operations of Love in
 the Human Spirit

**
¶1:** This
 love
, which is active and manifest in the
 human spirit as
 it exists
 in the world today
, performs five spiritual
 operations.

**¶2:**
 The first operation it
 performs is this: it
 consumes and transforms all
 natural good, and every merely
 external
 thing that is submitted to it.


**¶3:** The second:
 it separates four distinct
 aspects from
 within
 that
 natural good, which are these —
 the
 hidden
 love and the
 hidden wisdom that lay
 conce
aled within it, and
 the merely corporeal residue and the
 falsity
 that clung
 to it.
 Love
 draws
 out what is of
 love
;
 wisdom draws out what is of wisdom;
 what
 is dead
 and
 earthly falls
 away;
 and
 what is confused
 and obscure
 rises off
 and
 diss
ipates.

**¶4
:** The third: it gives the perception
 of good and the delight of interior
 truth to every
 understanding
 that undergoes transformation through it. It
 also gives the warmth of affection
 and spiritual
 gladness to whoever
 draws into
 conjunction
 with it.

**¶5
:** The fourth operation it
 performs:
 all the formative faculties of the
 mind
 shape the receiving
 vessels
 —
 the containing forms of truth and good —
 by means of it.
 No
 interior
 form
 is fash
ioned except
 through love.

**¶6
:** The fifth:
 it brings
 forth
 wisdom into
 manifest
ation, and by
 that wisdom human minds perceive and understand
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This fire, which burns and is apparent today in the world, it does five works.
The first work that it does is this: It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.
The second: It separates four aspects of the wood, which are these: fire and light, ash and smoke.
The third: It gives a taste and an aroma to whatever will be cooked on it. It also gives heat and cheer to whoever will be close to it.
The fourth work that [it] does: All craftsmen shall work the utensils that they will fabricate in it.
The fifth: It shall display light, and the people see by [it].
